title: Verify runtime and checkpoint contracts
claim_rule: No inference about model quality before interface parity

title: Verify simulator replay and render invariance
claim_rule: Failed replay invalidates downstream causal interpretation

title: Replicate native prediction and planning
primary_endpoint: native trajectory error and task behavior
suggested_size: 20-30 native smoke episodes then qualified development bank
claim_rule: Useful native competence required for interpretability

title: Build physical and appearance pairs
suggested_size: 128 pilot families then full 3384-family allocation shared across compatible models
claim_rule: Exclude only prespecified invalid initializations before outcomes

title: Qualify independent physical readouts
claim_rule: Readout validity is not proof of absence of other encodings

title: Qualify clean semantic editors
suggested_size: up to 2000 editor-fit families and 256 validation families
claim_rule: Do not interpret nuisance failure if clean editing fails

title: Run damage and specificity controls
suggested_size: shared development roots and equal tuning budgets
claim_rule: Rule out generic damage and weak-editor strawman

title: Test locked semantic transport interaction
suggested_size: initial target 400 fresh roots and 8 candidates with horizons 1-4-8
claim_rule: Retain all registered roots and report each checkpoint separately

title: Measure executed counterfactual regret
suggested_size: 32 candidates on full or prospectively fixed root subset
claim_rule: Regret is relative to the tested bank not global optimality

title: Separate forecast and goal-cost failures
claim_rule: Diagnostic contrasts are not a nonnegative additive decomposition

title: Check measurement and fitting robustness
primary_endpoint: effect stability across readouts and editor seeds
suggested_size: three editor seeds if feasible with root-clustered intervals
claim_rule: Editor seeds are not world-model training replications

title: Compare augmentation and temporal supervision
suggested_size: four fixed training conditions with fresh evaluation protocol
claim_rule: Use simple augmentation if it matches the proposed repair

title: Replicate in single-cube manipulation
claim_rule: No extrapolation from PushT without task qualification

title: Add independent checkpoints or deployment test
suggested_size: only after measured budget and separate protocol
claim_rule: Do not equate counterfactual query utility with ordinary task success
